package.description: 对话优先的桌面 AI 助手，All in Chat

en-US.description: A chat-first desktop AI assistant, all in chat
en-US.longDescription:
Use it as an everyday chat app; hand it a folder and it gets to work — reading code, editing files, running commands. It can also handle repetitive chores on a schedule, and you can keep chatting from your phone when you're away from your computer.

✨ Highlights

🗣️ All in Chat
Just say it in the chat: create a persona, set up a scheduled task, remember a habit, mount a folder… No digging through settings — click confirm and it's done.
🎭 Multiple personas, each with a specialty
Ships with Deva, an all-round assistant, and 小码酱 (Xiaomajiang), a security research expert. Create your own too — each with its own personality, avatar and preferred model.
🤖 Subagents, multi-agent dispatch
Big tasks get split up and dispatched to multiple subagents running in parallel — or in the background when the result isn't needed right away. Four built-in types — General, Explore, Research and Plan — each with its own context, returning only the conclusions.
⏪ Broke something? Roll it back
/rewind to before any turn. Code and conversation can be restored separately, and a rewind can itself be undone.
⏰ Scheduled tasks
Create a task with one sentence; it runs on time and notifies you when done. Supports daily, weekly, monthly and cron.
📱 Keep chatting in IM
Connect your favorite chat app. Away from your computer, messages from your phone go straight to Deva on your desktop.

zh-CN.description: 对话优先的桌面 AI 助手，All in Chat
zh-CN.longDescription:
平时当聊天工具用；给它一个文件夹，它就能直接动手——看代码、改文件、跑命令。还能帮你定时做些重复的事，人不在电脑前，也能用手机接着聊。

✨ 亮点

🗣️ All in Chat
要做的事都在对话里说一句：建角色、建定时任务、记住习惯、挂载文件夹……不用翻设置页，你点个确认就办好。
🎭 多角色，各有所长
内置全能助手 Deva 和安全研究专家小码酱；也能自己建角色，每个都有独立的性格、头像和常用模型。
🤖 子智能体，自动派发多 Agent
大任务自动拆开，派给多个子智能体并行跑，不急着要结果的还能放到后台；内置通用、检索、调研、方案四种，各有独立上下文，只把结论交回来。
⏪ 改坏了能退回去
/rewind 回到任意一轮之前，代码、对话可分开恢复，回退了还能撤销。
⏰ 定时任务
一句话建任务，到点自动跑，跑完弹通知；支持每天、每周、每月、cron。
📱 IM 里接着聊
把常用的聊天工具接进来，人不在电脑前，用手机发消息就是在电脑上的 Deva 里对话。
zh-CN.name: Deva
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
新功能 / New Features
- 成员工具按需加载，优化成员待办回执与联想替换 / defer member tools and refine member asks and mention replacement
- 生成中头像底板变为转动的星芒，取代扫光 / morph avatar plate into a spinning burst while generating, replacing sweep
- 头像悬停改为整枚压暗，配色选项排成一行 / darken whole avatar on hover and fit color pickers in one row
- 运行历史标题右侧新增「查看对话」入口 / add view chat link beside task run history header
- 会话中的定时任务可被主角色追问，告知改为发送最终回复原文 / let owner query in-session scheduled tasks and send final replies as informs
- 支持按路径附加文件并独立成员文件夹 / support path-only attachments and independent member folders
- 新增成员 report_to_main 工具，把需主智能体处理的事转交给它 / add report_to_main tool for members to hand off work to the main agent
- 成员支持请用户在网页上操作并可接续未完成任务 / let members request browser handoff and resume unfinished tasks
- 头像支持 13 种底板形状与探出构图 / add 13 avatar plate shapes and pop-out composition
- 新增 tool_search 按需加载工具 / add tool_search for on-demand loading of tool usage
- 附件改为图片缩略图与文件卡片，支持应用内看大图 / show image thumbnails and file cards for attachments with in-app viewer
- 定时任务可绑定创建它的对话，并把结果交给主角色 / let scheduled tasks bind to their origin chat and hand off results
- 超长工具结果存文件，缓存过期后清理旧结果 / spill long tool outputs to files and clear stale results after cache expiry
- 成员交差改为以自身身份直接回复，新增派发组进度提示与出错处理 / show member reports under member identity, add dispatch progress and error handling
- 新增 member_status 工具并完善成员管理与上下文读取 / add member_status tool and improve member management and context reading
- 新增项目成员机制，支持派任务与独立工作 / add project members for task delegation and independent work
- 支持拖入文件夹作为附件，仅传路径给模型 / support dragging folders as attachments with location passed to model
问题修复 / Bug Fixes
- 修复浮层右键冒泡误弹对话菜单的问题 / fix portal context menu bubbling into conversation menu
- 按各家现行上限更新内置上下文窗口表 / update built-in context windows to current provider limits
- macOS 图标按系统网格留透明边距 / add transparent margins to the macOS icon per the system icon grid
- 检查更新优先查 GitHub API，失败再读网页 / query GitHub API first for updates and fall back to the web page
- 修复开代理时检查更新报 HTTP 403 的问题 / fix update check failing with HTTP 403 behind a proxy
- 修复预发布版收不到同号正式版更新的问题 / fix prerelease installs not offered the matching stable release
- 出站请求改走 Chromium 网络栈并给出明确的网络错误说明 / route outbound requests through Chromium networking with clear network error messages
- AI 生成提交信息改用当前对话的模型 / use the current conversation's model for AI commit messages
其他改进 / Other Improvements
- 简化任务详情的绑定对话展示，用图标区分两种任务 / simplify task detail binding display, distinguish task types by icon
完整变更 / Full Changelog: https://github.com/sqfcyily/deva/compare/v0.1.13...v0.1.14
